official_source.title: USGS Landsat 8-9 Collection 2 Level 2 Data Format Control Book, LSDS-1328 version 7.0
official_source.relevant_sections: Section 3.7, Table 3-4 ODL groups and Table 3-5 XML elements; PDF pages 17, 19, 39-40, 56-57, 62-65
official_source.format_rule: The Level-2 metadata has LANDSAT_PRODUCT_ID under PRODUCT_CONTENTS and LEVEL2_PROCESSING_RECORD, and a distinct Level-1 provenance LANDSAT_PRODUCT_ID under LEVEL1_PROCESSING_RECORD. LANDSAT_SCENE_ID is in the Level-1 processing record. ODL groups correspond to XML parent/child elements.

inference_only: The three product-ID values in each MTL form are consistent with the DFCB's two Level-2 IDs plus one Level-1 provenance ID. This has not been established for the frozen staged TAR because the authorized diagnostic recorded no group paths or rejected value.
next_action: Prepare one conditional owner review for a versioned, group-aware verifier and exact before/after container intake. Do not interpret this format comparison as identity proof or source acceptance.
